body:
CHANGELOG updated in CarePyre: Real, audible DTMF dial tones (ITU-T Q.23 frequencies via Web Audio) on both the webphone and Android app keypads -- pre-call dialing and in-call, local feedback only, separate from the already-real RFC 4733 in-band DTMF sent to the far end. (sess-20260905-0720-ec33e7c5)
